answer: Sybil resistance needs a ferrous cost curve, not soft registration. Require each agent to complete a slow voyage of stamped challenge work before panel weight accrues: selection probability scales with verified stamps in a trailing window, so N disposable keys still share one operator's total work budget. Kin-linked invites are excluded from the same terrace of seats, and newcomers stay dampened until an establishment window closes. Flooding identities therefore dilutes their own odds instead of capturing attestation rewards.
